openings.claim: Coupling recorded-boundary digest comparisons to a provenance ledger may improve earliest-supported divergence reports. Each comparison carries manifest order, record identifiers and missingness into claims and unresolved intervals; mismatches remain separate from explanations. Blank warnings and absent records imply neither success nor nonexecution; timestamp inversion remains an anomaly, not reordered stages.
openings.discriminator: Against independent digest results plus a ledger, intact coupling should reduce unsupported definite claims or narrow correctly bounded intervals. Additive benefit predicts equivalent reports with links broken. Accurate equality defeats coupling advantage; narrower but incorrect intervals also defeat it.
openings.probe: Cache supplied fields with at most twelve manual inspections per pair; log counts. Produce exploratory baseline stage-order, digest-alone, ledger-alone, intact coupling and link-broken reports. Broken links preserve both parent contents but remove comparison-to-claim boundary links. Compare intact versus broken on two disjoint three-pair subsets within twenty additional minutes. Freeze outputs before opening two sealed answer sheets; score only covered boundaries. During final review randomly remove one transform record from each of two pairs, retaining manifests. Score supported-stage correctness, interval coverage/width, citations, next-check feasibility, inspections, setup minutes and link-maintenance edits. Shared-input ablations establish no independent performance effects.
openings.uncertainty: No physical synergy or measured improvement is claimed. Use the supplied spreadsheet/script within sixty analyst minutes; stop before inspection/time limits, retaining unresolved intervals. Every definite claim cites a supplied record; earliest follows manifest order without assuming unrecorded execution. Report all six pairs with stage/interval, record references and a supplied-boundary-field or manifest-entry next check requiring no live access. If maintenance exhausts capacity or broken links perform equally, retain independent parents; usefulness remains uncertain.
